The new energy policy resulted in significant savings for the company. (新的能源政策為公司省下可觀成本。)
Scaffolding has been set up around the exterior of the building for repairs. (建築物外圍已搭起鷹架，以便進行維修。)
All job applicants undergo a background screening process. (所有求職者都必須經過背景資料審查。)
Regular scrubbing of the laboratory surfaces is required for hygiene. (為了維持衛生，實驗室表面需要定期刷洗。)

meaning: n. 座位安排；座席配置
example: The conference hall has flexible seating arrangements to accommodate different group sizes. (會議廳採用彈性的座位安排，以容納不同規模的團體。)
We have secured the funding necessary to launch the new project. (我們已取得啟動新專案所需的資金。)
The selected candidates will be invited for a second interview. (獲選的候選人將受邀參加第二輪面試。)
Employees are trained in basic self-defense during the workshop. (員工在工作坊期間接受基礎防身訓練。)
Positive feedback can significantly improve an employee's self-esteem. (正面的回饋能顯著提升員工的自尊。)
The Taipei office is serving regional clients while Singapore handles strategic accounts. (台北辦公室負責服務區域客戶，新加坡則處理策略客戶。)
The conference will be held in a professional office setting. (研討會將在專業的辦公環境中舉行。)
The final showing of the training video is at 4:00 PM. (培訓影片的最後一場放映時間是下午四點。)
We have some free time for sightseeing after the conference. (會議結束後，我們有一些空檔可以觀光。)
The company office is situated in the downtown business district. (公司辦公室位於市中心的商業區。)

meaning: adj. 熟練的；有專業技能的
example: We are looking for skilled technicians to join our maintenance team. (我們正在尋找熟練的技術人員加入維護團隊。)
The company is closely monitoring its spending this quarter. (公司本季正密切監控支出。)
He spoke to the staff about the new company policy. (他向員工說明新的公司政策。)
There is no standing room left in the conference hall. (會議廳已沒有可供站立的空間。)

meaning: adj. 餓極了的；非常飢餓的
example: I am starving; let's go get some lunch. (我快餓壞了；我們去吃午餐吧。)
The new laboratory is equipped with state-of-the-art technology. (新實驗室配備了最先進的技術。)

meaning: adj. 意志堅定的；堅強果斷的
example: She is a strong-willed leader who can overcome any obstacle. (她是一位意志堅定的領導者，能克服各種障礙。)
Because the sales team lacks data, supporting documents should be attached to every proposal. (由於業務團隊缺乏資料，每份提案都應附上佐證文件。)
If construction affects surrounding businesses, the developer must communicate the schedule clearly. (如果施工影響周邊商家，開發商必須清楚說明施工時程。)
The marketing team is discussing new tactics to increase engagement. (行銷團隊正在討論提升參與度的新策略。)

meaning: adj. 量身打造的；依需求調整的
example: The training program was tailored to meet our specific needs. (這項訓練計畫是依照我們的特定需求量身打造的。)

meaning: adj. 客製化的；量身訂做的
example: We offer tailor-made solutions for all of our clients. (我們為所有客戶提供量身打造的解決方案。)

meaning: adj. 有才華的；有天分的
example: She is a talented designer with a great eye for detail. (她是一位有才華的設計師，對細節很有眼光。)

meaning: adj. 顯示重要資訊的；有說服力的
example: The sales report provided a telling insight into our market performance. (銷售報告深入揭示了我們的市場表現。)

meaning: adj. 有主題的；以特定主題設計的
example: We are organizing a themed party for the team's holiday celebration. (我們正為團隊的假期慶祝活動籌辦主題派對。)

meaning: adj. 令人振奮的；令人激動的
example: The success of the project was a thrilling moment for the team. (專案成功對團隊而言是令人振奮的時刻。)

meaning: adj. 蓬勃發展的；興旺的
example: Our company is thriving in the current market conditions. (我們公司在目前的市場環境中蓬勃發展。)
Please ensure your timecard is submitted by the end of the week. (請確保在本週結束前提交工時卡。)
Manual data entry is a very time-consuming task. (人工輸入資料是一項非常耗時的工作。)

meaning: adj. 頂級的；最高規格的
example: We use top-of-the-line equipment for all our manufacturing processes. (我們所有製造流程都使用頂級設備。)
The company focuses on the trading of agricultural goods. (該公司專注於農產品貿易。)
Because the software was upgraded, mandatory training will be provided before full implementation. (由於軟體已升級，全面導入前會提供必要訓練。)
The trimming of the office trees will be done this weekend. (辦公室樹木的修剪工作將於本週末進行。)
We accidentally undercharged the client for the services. (我們不小心少收了客戶的服務費。)
We need to address the underlying cause of the problem. (我們需要處理這個問題的根本原因。)

meaning: adj. 人手不足的；人力短缺的
example: The department is currently understaffed, so work is piling up. (該部門目前人手不足，因此工作不斷堆積。)
We have an understanding of the client's needs. (我們了解客戶的需求。)

meaning: adj. 堅定不移的；毫不動搖的
example: He has shown unwavering commitment to the team's success. (他展現了對團隊成功堅定不移的承諾。)

meaning: adj. 起伏不定的；時好時壞的
example: The project progress has been up-and-down this month. (本月專案進度起伏不定。)

meaning: adj. 最新的；保持更新的
example: Please ensure your contact information is up-to-date. (請確保您的聯絡資訊維持最新。)

meaning: n. 貴重物品；值錢物品
example: Please keep your valuables in the secure locker. (請將您的貴重物品存放在安全置物櫃中。)
We have some visiting scholars from the partner university. (有幾位來自合作大學的訪問學者在我們這裡。)
She voiced her concerns about the project timeline. (她表達了對專案時程的擔憂。)
The company posted a "help wanted" sign in the window. (公司在櫥窗張貼了「徵人啟事」。)

meaning: n. 暖身活動；開場活動
example: Let's do a brief warm-up before starting the project discussion. (開始專案討論前，我們先做個簡短的暖身活動。)

meaning: adj. 抗水的；具防潑水功能的
example: This watch is water-resistant, but not waterproof. (這支手錶具抗水功能，但並非完全防水。)
The welding of the steel frame is complete. (鋼架的焊接已完成。)

meaning: adj. 均衡的；平衡良好的
example: A well-balanced diet is important for staying healthy. (均衡的飲食對維持健康很重要。)
Our goal is to ensure the well-being of all employees. (我們的目標是維護所有員工的身心健康。)

meaning: adj. 受過良好教育的；學識豐富的
example: We have a team of well-educated professionals. (我們擁有一支受過良好教育的專業團隊。)
He is willing to help if you ask him. (如果你開口請他幫忙，他會很樂意協助。)

meaning: n. 逛街看櫥窗；只逛不買
example: We enjoyed window-shopping during our lunch break. (我們利用午休時間逛街看櫥窗，享受只逛不買的樂趣。)
The project manager addressed a couple of critical issues during the briefing. (專案經理在簡報中處理了幾個關鍵問題。)
The recent fluctuations in exchange rates have cost the manufacturing sector a great deal. (近期匯率波動讓製造業損失慘重。)

meaning: phr. 聯外道路；通行道路
example: Construction of the new access road to the industrial park will commence next month. (通往工業區的新聯外道路將於下個月動工。)

meaning: phr. 應付帳款；尚未支付的款項
example: The finance department is currently reviewing all accounts payable to optimize cash flow. (財務部目前正在審查所有應付帳款，以優化現金流。)

meaning: phr. 廣告活動；宣傳企畫
example: The launch of the new product line will be supported by a robust, multi-channel advertising campaign. (新產品線上市時，將搭配大規模的多通路廣告活動推廣。)
We shouldn't penalize the vendor for the delay; after all, the extreme weather was unprecedented. (我們不該因延誤而懲罰供應商；畢竟這種極端天氣前所未見。)
The project sponsor promised to support our ambitious initiative all the way to completion. (專案贊助人承諾會一路支持我們的計畫，直到完成為止。)
The corporation rented out the entire amusement park for its annual employee appreciation day. (公司包下整座遊樂園，舉辦年度員工感謝日。)

meaning: phr. 陳年往事；早已過去的事
example: The fierce rivalry between the two legacy tech companies is now essentially ancient history. (這兩家老牌科技公司之間的激烈競爭，如今基本上已成陳年往事。)
Job applicants must fill out this employment application form clearly and accurately, without any omissions. (求職者必須清楚、正確地填寫這份工作申請表，不得有任何遺漏。)

meaning: phr. 照目前情況；本來就
example: The proposed budget is tight as it is; any further reductions will severely compromise project quality. (提議的預算本來就很吃緊；再刪減會嚴重影響專案品質。)
The highly secure server is designed to process over a million encrypted transactions at a time. (這台高安全性的伺服器設計上可一次處理超過一百萬筆加密交易。)

meaning: phr. 不惜任何代價；無論如何
example: The management team is absolutely determined to avert a hostile takeover bid at all costs. (經營團隊下定決心，不惜任何代價也要避免遭到惡意併購。)

meaning: phr. 整體而言；普遍來說
example: The board's sudden decision to oust the CEO took the business community at large by surprise. (董事會突然罷免執行長的決定，讓整個商界都感到意外。)
The sophisticated software allows the system administrator to monitor dozens of network nodes at once. (這套精密軟體讓系統管理員能同時監控數十個網路節點。)
The company strives to increase its market share and, at the same time, reduce its carbon footprint. (公司致力於提高市占率，同時減少碳足跡。)

meaning: phr. 備份；製作備用副本
example: It is mandatory protocol to back up all crucial corporate data to a secure cloud server daily. (每天將所有重要公司資料備份至安全的雲端伺服器，是一項強制規定。)

meaning: phr. 銀行帳戶；銀行存款帳戶
example: Please verify that the routing number is correct before transferring the funds to the offshore bank account. (將資金匯入離岸銀行帳戶前，請先確認銀行代碼正確。)

meaning: phr. 銀行貸款；銀行借款
example: The aggressive expansion plan was entirely financed through a high-interest commercial bank loan. (這項積極的擴張計畫完全仰賴高利率商業銀行貸款籌資。)

meaning: phr. 被稱為；以……身分聞名
example: The visionary entrepreneur is widely known as a disruptive pioneer in the renewable energy sector. (這位富有遠見的企業家被廣泛視為再生能源領域的顛覆性先驅。)
The contested patent rights ultimately belong to the independent researcher, not the conglomerate that funded the study. (這項有爭議的專利權最終屬於獨立研究員，而不是出資進行研究的企業集團。)

meaning: phr. 自行車架；腳踏車停放架
example: To promote eco-friendly commuting, the firm installed a secure, covered bicycle rack in the underground parking garage. (為推廣環保通勤，公司在地下停車場設置了安全且有遮棚的自行車架。)
The corporate wellness program offers free bi-monthly health screenings, including blood pressure and cholesterol checks. (企業健康計畫每兩個月提供免費健康檢查，包括血壓和膽固醇檢測。)
The pivotal decision to acquire the struggling competitor will be put to a vote at tomorrow's emergency board meeting. (收購那家經營困難的競爭對手這項關鍵決策，將在明天的緊急董事會議上表決。)
The board of directors holds the ultimate fiduciary responsibility to act in the best interests of the company's shareholders. (董事會負有最終受託責任，必須以公司股東的最佳利益為依歸行事。)
Passengers must present a valid passport and printed boarding pass to the security personnel before entering the sterile area. (旅客進入管制區前，必須向安檢人員出示有效護照和紙本登機證。)
The chemical plant was heavily fined for illegally discharging toxic wastewater into a nearby body of water. (這家化工廠因非法將有毒廢水排入附近水域而遭重罰。)
The corporate retreat was hosted at a serene botanical garden to promote mindfulness and team cohesion among the executives. (主管共識營在一座幽靜的植物園舉行，藉此促進主管的正念與團隊凝聚力。)

meaning: phr. 逐項拆解；分項說明
example: Can you please break down the exorbitant travel expenses in the budget proposal line by line? (請問你能否逐項拆解預算提案中高得驚人的差旅費？)
The implementation of the agile framework is intended to bring about a significant increase in software development efficiency. (導入敏捷框架旨在大幅提升軟體開發效率。)
The wildly successful holiday promotional campaign managed to bring in record-breaking revenue for the quarter. (大獲成功的假期促銷活動為本季帶來了破紀錄的營收。)
The severe economic downturn was largely brought on by the unprecedented disruption to the global supply chain. (這場嚴重的經濟衰退，很大程度上是全球供應鏈遭遇前所未有的中斷所造成的。)
The rigorous executive leadership program is meticulously designed to bring out the untapped potential in promising managers. (這項嚴謹的高階主管培訓計畫經過精心設計，旨在激發有潛力的經理人尚未發揮的能力。)
During the strategic planning session, the CFO thoughtfully brought up the critical issue of dwindling cash reserves. (在策略規劃會議中，財務長審慎地提出現金儲備日益減少這個關鍵問題。)
The HR department posted the revised employee benefit scheme on the company's internal bulletin board. (人資部將修訂後的員工福利方案張貼在公司內部公告欄。)

meaning: phr. 偶然遇見；碰巧碰到
example: I coincidentally bumped into our former CFO at the international tech expo in Frankfurt. (我在法蘭克福的國際科技博覽會上偶然遇見了前任財務長。)
The shuttle service departs from the main bus stop adjacent to the corporate headquarters every fifteen minutes. (接駁車每十五分鐘從企業總部旁的主要公車站出發。)
We exchanged business cards after realizing our respective companies could mutually benefit from a strategic partnership. (發現雙方公司都能從策略合作中受益後，我們交換了名片。)

meaning: phr. 商業交易；商業協議
example: The protracted negotiations ultimately culminated in a multi-million dollar business deal between the two tech giants. (漫長談判最終促成兩家科技巨頭之間數百萬美元的商業交易。)

meaning: phr. 敲定；完成最後細節
example: We need to button up the final draft of the acquisition proposal before presenting it to the board of directors. (向董事會簡報前，我們需要敲定收購提案最終草案的細節。)
If you require any further clarification on the revised tax regulations, by all means, do not hesitate to contact me. (如果您對修訂後的稅務規定還需要進一步說明，請務必隨時聯絡我。)
The highly confidential legal documents were delivered by hand to ensure maximum security and privacy. (這些高度機密的法律文件由專人親自送達，以確保最高程度的安全與隱私。)
The preliminary market research is insightful, but it is by no means a guarantee of the product's ultimate success. (初步市場調查很有參考價值，但絕不保證產品最終會成功。)

meaning: phr. 回電；稍後再打電話
example: I am currently occupied in an urgent board meeting; I will call you back as soon as we adjourn. (我目前正在參加緊急董事會議；會議一結束就會立刻回電給你。)
The escalating consumer inflation rates call for immediate and decisive intervention by the central bank. (消費者通膨率持續攀升，因此需要中央銀行立即果斷介入。)
Management decided to call off the highly anticipated merger after discovering massive hidden liabilities during due diligence. (管理層在盡職調查中發現巨額隱藏負債後，決定取消備受期待的合併案。)
The charismatic political leader called on his supporters to actively participate in the upcoming grassroots campaign. (這位魅力十足的政治領袖號召支持者積極參與即將展開的草根運動。)

meaning: phr. 公開指出；點名批評
example: The senior auditor did not hesitate to publicly call out the glaring discrepancies in the quarterly financial statements. (資深稽核員毫不猶豫地公開指出季度財務報表中明顯的差異。)
All car rental expenses incurred during the business trip must be meticulously documented and submitted for reimbursement. (出差期間產生的所有租車費用，都必須詳實記錄並提交核銷。)
The newly appointed HR director genuinely seems to care for the well-being and professional growth of her subordinates. (新任人資主管似乎真心關心下屬的身心福祉與職涯成長。)
The retail chain is upgrading every outdated cash register with state-of-the-art point-of-sale terminal systems. (這家零售連鎖店正將每一台老舊收銀機升級為最先進的銷售點終端系統。)
All critical policy decisions and high-level strategic directives must be unequivocally approved by the central office in London. (所有重要政策決策與高層策略指示，都必須獲得倫敦總部明確批准。)

meaning: phr. 執行長；執行長職位
example: The newly appointed CEO outlined an aggressive five-year plan focused exclusively on rapid international market expansion. (新任執行長提出一項積極的五年計畫，專注於快速拓展國際市場。)
All conference attendees are strictly required to check in at the main reception desk to receive their official credentials and itineraries. (所有研討會與會者都必須在主接待櫃檯報到，領取正式證件和行程表。)
Before you check out of the hotel, please meticulously review the itemized billing statement to ensure all room charges are completely accurate. (離開飯店辦理退房前，請仔細核對明細帳單，確認所有客房費用都完全正確。)

meaning: phr. 財務長；首席財務官
example: The Chief Financial Officer successfully guided the corporation through an exceptionally turbulent economic recession. (財務長成功帶領公司度過極為動盪的經濟衰退。)
To proactively attract and retain top-tier talent, the progressive tech firm offers heavily subsidized on-site child care facilities. (為積極吸引並留住頂尖人才，這家前瞻性的科技公司提供高額補助的公司內托育設施。)
The struggling local newspaper still heavily relies on revenue generated from its rapidly dwindling daily classified ad section. (經營困難的地方報紙仍高度依賴日益縮小的每日分類廣告版面所帶來的收入。)
The newly appointed mayor aggressively vowed to thoroughly clean up the widespread corruption deeply plaguing the city's public works department. (新任市長強硬承諾要徹底整頓重創市府公共工程部門的廣泛貪腐。)

Failing to consistently meet stringent profitability targets, the multinational retailer was eventually forced to permanently close down several underperforming flagship stores. (由於始終無法達到嚴格的獲利目標，這家跨國零售商最終被迫永久關閉數家績效不佳的旗艦店。)
The ambitious infrastructure project is finally starting to come along nicely after facing numerous severely debilitating initial delays. (這項雄心勃勃的基礎建設計畫在初期歷經多次嚴重延誤後，終於開始順利推進。)
Under the intense scrutiny of the aggressive investigative journalists, the CEO's carefully constructed narrative quickly began to come apart. (在咄咄逼人的調查記者嚴密檢視下，執行長精心建構的說法很快開始瓦解。)
The regional manager asked the newly appointed branch director to come over to the headquarters for a highly confidential strategic briefing. (區域經理請新任分公司主管到總部來，參加高度機密的策略簡報。)

meaning: phr. 小型車；緊湊型轎車
example: Renting a fuel-efficient compact car is far more practical for navigating the notoriously narrow, winding streets of the historic district. (要在歷史街區以狹窄、蜿蜒聞名的道路上行駛，租一輛省油的小型車實用得多。)

meaning: phr. 電話會議；視訊會議
example: We have scheduled a conference call with our regional partners to align our sales targets for the next quarter. (我們已安排與區域合作夥伴召開電話會議，協調下一季的銷售目標。)
The primary conference room has been reserved for the duration of the budget planning session next Tuesday. (主要會議室已預訂供下週二的預算規劃會議全程使用。)

meaning: phr. 利益衝突；利害關係衝突
example: All employees are required to disclose any potential conflict of interest to the HR department before undertaking outside projects. (所有員工在承接外部專案前，都必須向人資部揭露任何潛在的利益衝突。)

meaning: phr. 轉機航班；接駁航班

The company had to let go several employees due to a decline in project orders. (由於專案訂單減少，公司不得不解雇幾名員工。)

meaning: phr. 預期壽命；平均壽命

Please line up in an orderly fashion at the registration desk for the seminar. (請在研討會報到櫃檯依序排隊。)
The plant manager thanked the line workers for their commitment to maintaining production quality. (廠長感謝生產線員工致力於維持產品品質。)
Please direct all incoming deliveries to the loading dock at the back of the building. (請將所有送達貨物引導至建築物後方的裝卸區。)

The junior staff look up to him for his extensive experience and leadership skills. (年輕員工敬重他豐富的經驗與領導能力。)

meaning: phr. 郵寄名單；電子郵件名單
example: Please add your email address to our mailing list to receive updates on our latest products. (請將您的電子郵件地址加入我們的郵件名單，以接收最新產品資訊。)
Please make sure all doors are locked before you leave the building for the day. (當天離開大樓前，請務必確認所有門都已上鎖。)
The appraisal determined the current market value of the property to be significantly higher than expected. (鑑價結果顯示，該房產目前的市場價值遠高於預期。)
The hospital has expanded its maternity ward to accommodate the growing number of patients. (醫院擴建了產科病房，以容納日益增加的患者。)
I accidentally messed up the final report format, but I have already corrected it. (我不小心弄亂了最終報告的格式，不過已經修正了。)
The passenger suffered from motion sickness during the rough ferry ride to the island. (乘客搭乘顛簸的渡輪前往島上時，飽受暈船之苦。)
The office layout is designed to allow staff to move around easily between workstations. (辦公室的配置旨在讓員工能在各工作站之間輕鬆移動。)

meaning: phr. 國定假日；國家假日
example: The office will remain closed during the upcoming national holiday. (即將到來的國定假日期間，辦公室將暫停營業。)
The company reported a significant increase in net income for the second quarter. (公司報告第二季淨利大幅增加。)
Employees working the night shift receive a special compensation allowance. (上夜班的員工可領取特別津貼。)

I booked a nonstop flight to Tokyo to save time on my upcoming business trip. (為了節省即將出差的時間，我預訂了飛往東京的直飛航班。)

meaning: phr. 更不用說；此外還有
example: The software is very powerful, not to mention its incredibly intuitive user interface. (這套軟體功能強大，更不用說它的操作介面非常直覺。)

We conduct performance reviews on a regular basis to provide constructive feedback. (我們定期進行績效評估，提供具建設性的回饋。)

I don't believe that the error was made on purpose; it was likely an oversight. (我不認為這項錯誤是故意造成的；很可能只是疏忽。)
The interviewer offered him the position on the spot after a successful final interview. (最終面試順利結束後，面試官當場向他提供了這個職位。)
Please arrive on time for the meeting to ensure we cover all the agenda items. (請準時出席會議，確保我們能討論完所有議程。)
The business concept originated in a small startup back in 2010. (這個商業概念早在 2010 年便起源於一家小型新創公司。)
That specific industry guidebook is currently out of print. (那本特定的產業指南目前已經絕版。)
The item you requested is currently out of stock, but we expect a shipment next week. (您需要的品項目前缺貨，但預計下週會有新貨送達。)
Many common ailments can be treated with over-the-counter medicine. (許多常見的小病可以用非處方藥治療。)

meaning: phr. 有薪休假；帶薪年假
example: Employees are encouraged to use their paid vacation time to ensure a good work-life balance. (鼓勵員工使用有薪休假，維持良好的工作與生活平衡。)
Please pass around the handouts so everyone can follow the presentation. (請傳發講義，讓大家都能跟上簡報內容。)
I pass by the new construction site every morning on my way to work. (我每天早上上班途中都會經過新工地。)
Could you please pass out these survey forms at the end of the meeting? (請在會議結束時發放這些問卷，好嗎？)

meaning: phr. 略過；未選中（升遷等）
example: He was disappointed to be passed over for the promotion despite his hard work. (儘管工作努力，他仍未獲升遷，令他十分失望。)
It is a great opportunity, so do not pass up the chance to ask the keynote speaker a question. (這是難得的機會，別錯過向主題演講者提問的機會。)
We expect to pay off the bank loan within the next three years. (我們預計在未來三年內還清銀行貸款。)
The insurance company will pay out the claim once the investigation is complete. (調查完成後，保險公司將支付這筆理賠金。)
Please peel off the protective film before using the new equipment. (使用新設備前，請先撕下保護膜。)

meaning: phr. 個人物品；私人物件
example: Please ensure you have collected all your personal effects before you leave the office. (離開辦公室前，請確認已收拾好所有個人物品。)

meaning: phr. 物理治療；復健治療
example: The employee is currently undergoing physical therapy to recover from a back injury. (該員工目前正接受物理治療，以從背部受傷中康復。)
I need to pick up the new office supplies from the delivery center. (我得去配送中心領取新的辦公用品。)
Work tends to pile up if you do not manage your tasks effectively. (如果沒有有效管理任務，工作往往會逐漸堆積。)

meaning: phr. 個人識別碼；PIN 碼
example: Never write down your personal identification number, and keep it confidential. (切勿把個人識別碼寫下來，並務必妥善保密。)
The label indicates the place of origin for each of our imported products. (標籤上標明了每項進口產品的原產地。)
We booked the local playing field for the company sports day event. (我們預訂了當地運動場，作為公司運動日的活動場地。)
Please remember to plug in your laptop to charge it overnight. (請記得替筆記型電腦接上電源，讓它整晚充電。)
She was kind enough to point out the errors in my draft proposal. (她很熱心地指出我提案草稿中的錯誤。)
The alert will pop up on your screen when you receive a new email. (收到新電子郵件時，提醒通知會在螢幕上彈出。)
We are focusing on reducing costs to improve our overall profit margin. (我們正致力於降低成本，以提高整體利潤率。)
The fence marks the property line between our facility and the neighbor. (圍籬標示了我們的設施與鄰地之間的地界。)

meaning: phr. 國定假日；公眾假期
example: The office will be closed on the upcoming public holiday. (辦公室將在即將到來的國定假日休息。)

meaning: phr. 公共圖書館；公立圖書館
example: You can borrow professional books from the public library using your member card. (您可以使用借書證，從公共圖書館借閱專業書籍。)

meaning: phr. 公開演講；當眾發言
example: The training program includes a workshop on improving public speaking skills. (培訓計畫包含提升公開演講技巧的工作坊。)
The old warehouse will be pulled down to make room for a new facility. (舊倉庫將被拆除，為新設施騰出空間。)
The driver will pull up in front of the lobby to pick up the guests. (司機會把車停在大廳前接送賓客。)
Please issue a purchase order for the materials before placing the shipment request. (提出出貨申請前，請先開立材料採購單。)
The project deadline has been pushed back by one week. (專案截止期限已延後一週。)
Please put away your files before you leave your desk for the day. (今天離開座位前，請先收好文件。)
Please put down your pens when you have finished the written test. (完成筆試後，請放下筆。)
The manager put forward a proposal for a new team reward structure. (經理提出了新的團隊獎勵制度提案。)
He put in a lot of effort to ensure the presentation was perfect. (他投入了大量心力，確保簡報完美無缺。)
Never put off until tomorrow what you can do today. (今天能做的事，別拖到明天。)
Please put on your name tag before you enter the conference area. (進入會議區前，請戴上名牌。)

meaning: phr. 改天再約；改期再談
example: I can't join you for lunch today, but could I take a rain check? (我今天無法和您共進午餐，可以改天再約嗎？)
The preservation of the rain forest is crucial for global environmental health. (保護雨林對全球環境的健康至關重要。)
A brief rain shower occurred this afternoon, but it didn't disrupt the event. (今天下午下了一陣短暫的雨，但沒有影響活動。)
We are experiencing a shortage of raw materials for our production line. (我們的生產線正面臨原物料短缺。)
We sent the legal documents via registered mail to ensure they are tracked. (為了能追蹤寄件狀態，我們以掛號郵件寄出法律文件。)
We rely on our suppliers to deliver raw materials on time. (我們仰賴供應商準時交付原物料。)
The company decided to rent out the excess office space to a local startup. (公司決定把多餘的辦公空間出租給當地新創公司。)
Air pollution can have a negative effect on the human respiratory system. (空氣污染可能對人體呼吸系統造成負面影響。)

meaning: phr. 退休計畫；退休金制度

meaning: phr. 騎車離開；乘車離去

meaning: phr. 尖峰時段；交通尖峰

meaning: phr. 銷售代表；業務代表

meaning: phr. 座位容量；可容納人數

The policy sets forth the rules for remote work. (這項政策闡明了遠端工作的規則。)
The team set out to solve the problem early in the morning. (團隊一大早便開始著手解決問題。)
We need to set up the equipment for the presentation. (我們需要架設簡報所需的設備。)
We finally settled on the new design after reviewing many options. (檢視多種選項後，我們終於選定了新設計。)
It is common to shake hands when meeting a new business partner. (與新的商業夥伴見面時，握手是常見的禮節。)
He likes to show off his new computer to everyone. (他喜歡向大家炫耀自己的新電腦。)
Most of the staff showed up for the mandatory training. (大多數員工都出席了強制培訓。)
Please remember to shut down your computer before leaving the office. (離開辦公室前，請記得關閉電腦。)

The two new machines are placed side by side in the workshop. (兩台新機器並排放在工作區裡。)
The medication has a minor side effect of causing drowsiness. (這種藥物有一項輕微副作用，會引起嗜睡。)
You can sign up for the newsletter on our website. (您可以在我們的網站註冊電子報。)
Children love to slide down the slide in the public park. (孩子們喜歡從公園的溜滑梯上滑下來。)
So far, the pilot campaign has increased inquiries without raising advertising expenses. (到目前為止，試行活動在沒有增加廣告支出的情況下提高了詢問量。)
The sponge is great at soaking up spilled liquids. (這塊海綿很適合吸收打翻的液體。)
I am sort of busy today, can we talk tomorrow? (我今天有點忙，我們可以明天再談嗎？)
We need to sort out the logistics before the event. (我們需要在活動前安排好物流事宜。)
Could you speak up a little? I cannot hear you clearly. (可以請您大聲一點嗎？我聽不清楚。)

I had to stay up late to finish the report before the deadline. (我不得不熬夜，才能在截止期限前完成報告。)
Please keep both hands on the steering wheel while driving. (開車時請雙手握住方向盤。)
The CEO decided to step down after ten years of leadership. (執行長決定在領導公司十年後卸任。)

meaning: phr. 中途停留；短暫停留

The street sign was covered by a tree branch, so we missed the turn. (路牌被樹枝遮住了，所以我們錯過了轉彎處。)
The office is just a five-minute walk from the subway station. (辦公室距離地鐵站只要走五分鐘。)
The summit meeting focused on global trade policies. (這場高峰會議聚焦於全球貿易政策。)
The sterile surgical instruments are ready for use. (無菌手術器械已準備就緒，可以使用。)
Please switch off the lights when leaving the room. (離開房間時，請關掉燈。)
Please switch on the projector before the presentation. (簡報開始前請打開投影機。)
A table lamp is provided at every workstation. (每個工作站都配有一盞檯燈。)
He really takes after his father in terms of leadership style. (在領導風格方面，他真的很像父親。)

The plane will take off in about ten minutes. (飛機大約十分鐘後起飛。)
I cannot take on any more tasks this week. (我這週無法再承擔更多工作了。)
She will take over the project after the current manager leaves. (現任經理離職後，她將接手這項專案。)
The meeting will take place in the main conference room. (會議將在主會議室舉行。)
We should take turns presenting our project updates. (我們應該輪流報告專案進度。)
The old warehouse was torn down to make room for a new parking lot. (舊倉庫已拆除，以騰出空間興建新停車場。)
I received a telephone call from the client this morning. (我今天早上接到客戶打來的電話。)
Have you thought of a solution to the problem? (你想到解決這個問題的方法了嗎？)
Please take some time to think over the proposal. (請花點時間仔細考慮這項提案。)
We need to ensure that no third party has access to this data. (我們必須確保沒有任何第三方能存取這些資料。)
Please throw out any expired food items from the fridge. (請把冰箱裡任何過期食品丟掉。)
I am tied up with a meeting; can I call you later? (我正在開會走不開，可以晚點打給你嗎？)
There is a strict time limit for each presentation. (每場簡報都有嚴格的時間限制。)
Please request your time-off at least two weeks in advance. (請至少提前兩週申請休假。)

meaning: phr. 切中要點；簡潔扼要
example: His presentation was brief and to the point. (他的簡報簡短而切中要點。)

Please stop at the traffic light if it turns red. (如果紅綠燈轉紅，請停車。)

Please empty the trash bin at the end of each day. (請每天結束時清空垃圾桶。)
We booked our business travel through a travel agency. (我們透過旅行社預訂了商務行程。)
The tree trunk was damaged during the heavy storm. (樹幹在暴風雨中受損。)
New employees are subject to a three-month trial period. (新進員工須經過三個月的試用期。)
Our investment funds are managed by a professional trust company. (我們的投資基金由一家專業信託公司管理。)
You can try on the uniform in the fitting room. (您可以在試衣間試穿制服。)
We would like to try out the new software before buying it. (購買之前，我們想先試用這套新軟體。)
We had to turn away several late applicants. (我們不得不拒絕幾位遲到的申請者。)
The manager had to turn down the budget request. (經理不得不駁回這項預算申請。)
Employees must turn in expense reports before Friday if they want timely reimbursement. (員工若希望及時獲得報銷，必須在星期五前繳交費用報告。)
Please turn off unused equipment overnight, because electricity costs have increased sharply. (由於電費大幅上漲，請在夜間關閉未使用的設備。)
The event turned out to be a great success. (結果這場活動非常成功。)
Please turn over the page to see the next section. (請翻頁查看下一個部分。)
We had to turn to an expert for advice on this project. (這項專案我們只好向專家請教。)
The missing document finally turned up on my desk. (那份遺失的文件最後出現在我的桌上。)
Each branch manager may approve discounts up to 15 percent without headquarters’ consent. (各分店經理無須總部同意，即可核准最高 15% 的折扣。)
If the cartons are stored upside down, the fragile components may be damaged. (如果紙箱倒置存放，易碎零件可能會受損。)
There is a vending machine in the hallway for drinks. (走廊裡有一台販賣飲料的自動販賣機。)
We need to break the vicious cycle of low sales and cost-cutting. (我們必須打破銷售低迷與削減成本之間的惡性循環。)

meaning: phr. 語音信箱；語音留言
example: Please leave a message on my voice mail if I am away. (如果我不在，請在我的語音信箱留言。)
The waiter is waiting on a customer at the next table. (服務生正在招待隔壁桌的客人。)
Please have a seat in the waiting room until your turn. (請在等候室入座，直到輪到您。)

meaning: phr. 叫醒電話；晨間喚醒服務
example: I requested a wake-up call for 7:00 AM. (我預約了早上七點的叫醒電話。)

meaning: phr. 帶領參觀；逐步說明
example: The manager will walk through the new facility with us. (經理將帶我們參觀新設施。)
The washing machine in the staff breakroom is broken. (員工休息室的洗衣機壞了。)
The security guard will watch over the building at night. (保全人員會在夜間看守這棟建築。)
The water level in the reservoir is very low this year. (今年水庫的水位非常低。)
The watering can is kept in the storage room. (澆水壺放在儲藏室裡。)
The machine shows signs of normal wear and tear. (這台機器有正常耗損的跡象。)
These shoes will wear out if you walk in them daily. (如果每天穿著走路，這雙鞋會磨損。)
I checked the weather forecast before planning the outdoor event. (規劃戶外活動前，我先查看了天氣預報。)
Would you like some whipped cream on your coffee? (您想在咖啡上加些鮮奶油嗎？)
Please wipe off the dust from the screen. (請擦掉螢幕上的灰塵。)
We are currently working on a new marketing strategy. (我們目前正在制定新的行銷策略。)
If demand increases during holidays, supervisors may extend each work shift temporarily. (如果假日期間需求增加，主管可能會暫時延長每個班次。)
Let's wrap up this meeting and go to lunch. (我們結束這場會議，去吃午餐吧。)
Please write down the important points from the presentation. (請記下簡報中的重點。)
I need to write up a report on the meeting outcomes. (我需要撰寫一份會議成果報告。)

meaning: phr. 書寫便箋本；便條紙
example: I keep a writing pad on my desk for notes. (我在桌上放了一本便箋本來記錄事項。)
During the director's absence, Mei will act as the primary contact for vendors and regional office managers. (主管不在期間，Mei 將擔任供應商與區域辦公室經理的主要聯絡人。)

meaning: phr. 堅持立場；挺身表達
example: The new supervisor learned to assert herself during budget meetings while still inviting dissenting views from colleagues. (新任主管學會在預算會議中堅持立場，同時仍歡迎同事提出不同意見。)
The assistant foreman assigned crews to each loading bay and checked that all outgoing shipments had the correct labels. (助理領班將工作人員分派到各裝貨月台，並確認所有出貨都貼上正確標籤。)

meaning: phr. 權威人士；主管人物
example: New employees should know which authority figure can approve schedule changes when their direct supervisor is unavailable. (新進員工應知道，直屬主管不在時可由哪位主管核准排班變更。)
Before meeting the overseas distributor, the sales manager brushed up her knowledge of local customs and shipping terms. (拜訪海外經銷商前，業務經理複習了當地習俗與運送條件。)

meaning: phr. 員工餐飲設施；員工餐廳
example: The new office includes a cafeteria facility where employees can buy lunch without leaving the building during short breaks. (新辦公室設有員工餐廳，讓員工短暫休息時不用離開大樓也能買午餐。)
The supervisor checked up on new staff during their first week to ensure they had access to required systems. (主管在新進員工的第一週確認他們是否能使用所需系統。)

meaning: phr. 分類廣告；分類刊登
example: The restaurant placed a classified advertisement seeking an evening supervisor with previous experience managing customer service staff. (餐廳刊登分類廣告，徵求曾管理客服人員的晚班主管。)
Temporary staff must clock in at the reception terminal before reporting to their assigned work areas. (臨時人員須先在接待處的終端機打卡，再前往分派的工作區。)
Please clock out after returning the company vehicle and submitting the fuel receipts to your shift supervisor. (歸還公司車並把加油收據交給值班主管後，請記得下班打卡。)

meaning: phr. 團體協約；集體協議
example: The new collective agreement guarantees annual wage reviews and additional leave for warehouse employees with long service. (新的團體協約保障年度薪資檢討，並提供資深倉庫員工額外休假。)

meaning: phr. 集體談判；團體協商
example: Management began collective bargaining with the union after employees submitted proposals covering pay, scheduling, and workplace safety. (員工提出薪資、排班和職場安全提案後，管理階層與工會開始集體談判。)

meaning: phr. 挺身而出；主動提出
example: Two employees came forward with suggestions for reducing waste after management invited anonymous feedback. (管理階層徵求匿名意見後，有兩位員工主動提出減少浪費的建議。)
The director dressed down the contractor after repeated safety violations delayed the renovation schedule and raised costs. (承包商一再違反安全規定，拖延整修時程並增加成本，主管因此嚴厲斥責對方。)
The electrical engineer will inspect the new control system before the plant resumes production. (電機工程師將在工廠恢復生產前檢查新的控制系統。)
The candidate's experience is equal to the demands of the regional operations role, according to the hiring panel. (招募小組認為，這位候選人的經驗足以勝任區域營運職務。)
Staff received an extra duty allowance for covering weekend shifts during the inventory count. (員工在盤點期間支援週末班次，因此獲得額外津貼。)
The file clerk organized vendor contracts and scanned the updated records for the purchasing team. (檔案管理員整理供應商合約，並為採購團隊掃描更新後的紀錄。)
The new assistant fit in quickly and learned the office procedures within a few days. (新助理很快融入團隊，幾天內就學會辦公室流程。)
The offer includes a transit pass as a fringe benefit for employees who commute downtown. (聘用條件包含交通月票，作為通勤員工的額外福利。)
The factory hired additional garment workers to meet demand for the new uniform order. (工廠增聘成衣工人，以滿足新制服訂單的需求。)
The new finance manager gets on with colleagues by sharing information early and addressing disagreements directly. (新任財務經理提早分享資訊並直接處理歧見，因此和同事相處融洽。)
New dispatchers soon got the hang of the route-planning software after practicing with real delivery schedules. (新任調度員用實際配送時程練習後，很快就掌握了路線規劃軟體的操作方法。)
Employees should give notice at least two weeks before their final working day. (員工應在最後工作日前至少兩週提出離職通知。)
The mentoring program helps women overcome the glass ceiling and reach senior management positions. (導師計畫協助女性突破職場障礙，晉升高階管理職。)
After several shifts, the new receptionist had the visitor registration process down and could train temporary staff. (值了幾班後，新任接待人員已熟記訪客登記流程，能開始訓練臨時人員。)
Two experienced clerks helped out during the office move so customer records remained accessible throughout the weekend. (辦公室搬遷期間，兩位資深文員前來協助，讓客戶紀錄整個週末都能取用。)

meaning: phr. 相處融洽；一見如故
example: The new branch manager and the union representative hit it off during their first meeting about shift coverage. (新任分行經理與工會代表首次討論輪班安排時，就相處得很融洽。)

meaning: phr. 保住工作；維持職位
example: The night supervisor held down the position for six months until the company completed its regional leadership search. (公司完成區域主管遴選前，夜班主管暫時保住了這個職位六個月。)

meaning: phr. 資歷較淺；初階職位
example: Despite her junior status, the analyst led the client presentation because she knew the account best. (儘管資歷較淺，這位分析師仍主導客戶簡報，因為她最熟悉該帳戶。)
The hotel kept on several seasonal workers after bookings remained strong beyond the summer travel period. (夏季旅遊旺季過後，訂房仍很踴躍，飯店因此繼續聘用幾名季節性員工。)
The call center hired additional agents to keep up with the sharp rise in warranty questions after the product recall. (產品召回後保固詢問大幅增加，客服中心因此增聘人員以維持應對量能。)
The venue kicked out a disruptive guest after repeated warnings, allowing the conference reception to continue. (會場多次警告無效後，請鬧事賓客離場，讓會議招待會得以繼續。)
The committee will let in two additional reviewers before approving the final proposal. (委員會核准最終提案前，會再納入兩位審查人員。)
The supervisor let the employee off early after the afternoon training session ended. (下午訓練結束後，主管讓員工提早下班。)
During the labor dispute, management locked out workers at the factory entrance. (勞資爭議期間，管理層禁止工人進入工廠。)
The dress code requires a lounge suit for the annual awards reception. (年度頒獎酒會的服裝規定要求穿正式西裝。)

meaning: phr. 郵務文員；郵件管理員
example: The mail clerk sorted invoices and contracts before routing them to the appropriate departments. (郵務文員先分類發票與合約，再轉交給適當部門。)

meaning: phr. 體力勞動；勞力工作
example: The warehouse added automated carts to reduce manual labor during the late shift. (倉庫添購自動推車，以減少晚班的體力勞動。)

meaning: phr. 體力勞動；勞力工作
example: The factory redesigned the packing line to reduce manual labour without cutting staff hours. (工廠重新設計包裝線，以減少體力勞動而不縮短員工工時。)
The finalist measured up to the role's requirements, demonstrating sound judgment and steady communication during the panel interview. (最後入選者符合職務要求，在評審面談中展現良好判斷力和穩健的溝通能力。)

meaning: phr. 機械工程師；機械技師
example: The manufacturer hired a mechanical engineer to redesign the packaging line and lower maintenance costs. (製造商聘請機械工程師重新設計包裝線，降低維護成本。)

meaning: phr. 績效薪酬；功績加薪
example: The firm introduced merit pay for sales staff but set clear targets to prevent unfair evaluations. (公司為業務人員引進績效薪酬，並訂定明確目標以避免不公平評估。)
The recruiter arranged temporary housing and transport for every migrant worker arriving at the regional plant. (招募人員為每位抵達區域工廠的移工安排臨時住宿與交通。)
Her calm response to the difficult client made her a morale builder for the entire service team. (她冷靜應對難纏客戶，成了整個客服團隊的士氣推手。)

meaning: phr. 提振士氣；凝聚團隊
example: The supervisor scheduled a short team lunch as a morale building activity after the busy launch. (忙碌的上市活動結束後，主管安排簡短的團隊午餐來提振士氣。)
New staff receive safety training before they begin working on the job. (新進人員正式上工前會接受安全訓練。)

meaning: phr. 新人訓練；入職說明課
example: Every new hire attends an orientation course covering workplace policies, benefits, and emergency procedures. (每位新進員工都要參加入職說明課，了解職場規範、福利與緊急程序。)
The agency offers free career counseling to people who are out of work. (這家機構為失業者提供免費職涯諮詢。)
The company hired two part-time receptionists to cover evening shifts while full-time staff attended customer service training. (公司聘用兩名兼職櫃檯人員支援晚班，讓全職員工能參加客服訓練。)
The payroll department corrected the overtime calculation before issuing the monthly statements. (薪資部門在發出月結單前更正了加班費計算。)
The hiring manager picked out three applicants for a second interview after comparing their client support experience and references. (招募經理比較應徵者的客戶支援經驗和推薦資料後，挑出三人進入第二次面試。)

meaning: phr. 就業安置中心；職業介紹處
example: A placement center helped laid-off technicians connect with employers hiring for new infrastructure projects. (就業安置中心協助遭資遣的技術人員，媒合正在招募新基礎建設專案人才的雇主。)

meaning: phr. 就業介紹所；職業安置處
example: After the department closed, a placement office helped several experienced staff find suitable roles elsewhere. (部門關閉後，就業介紹所協助幾位資深員工在其他地方找到合適職位。)
Before the promotion interview, the supervisor helped the candidate polish up her presentation on recent customer retention results. (升遷面談前，主管協助候選人潤飾她近期客戶留存成果的簡報。)

meaning: phr. 證明實力；展現能力
example: The new account manager proved herself by retaining three clients who had considered moving their business to another provider. (新任客戶經理成功留住三位原本考慮轉往其他業者的客戶，證明了自己的能力。)
Every member of the support team must pull their weight during the product launch, especially when customer requests increase. (產品上市期間，支援團隊每位成員都必須盡本分，尤其是客戶需求增加時。)

meaning: phr. 齊心協力；通力合作
example: When a major shipment went missing, warehouse and customer service teams pulled together to locate it and update buyers. (一批重要貨物失聯時，倉庫和客服團隊齊心協力尋找貨物並通知買家。)
Hourly employees must punch in at the terminal before starting their shifts, and supervisors check missing entries each afternoon. (計時員工開始輪班前必須在終端機打卡，主管每天下午會檢查漏刷紀錄。)
Before leaving the warehouse, employees punch out on the time clock so payroll can calculate their paid hours accurately. (離開倉庫前，員工要在打卡鐘刷卡，讓薪資系統準確計算工時。)

meaning: phr. 種族歧視；種族差別待遇
example: The company revised its hiring policy after an investigation found racial discrimination in promotion decisions. (調查發現升遷決策涉及種族歧視後，公司修訂了聘僱政策。)
The regional coordinator is responsible for confirming venue access, arranging equipment delivery, and briefing the reception staff. (區域協調員負責確認場地使用、安排設備配送，並向接待人員說明工作。)
The coordinator rounded up all new employees for a brief welcome session before lunch. (協調人員在午餐前召集所有新進員工參加簡短的歡迎說明會。)
The recruiting software screens out incomplete applications before forwarding suitable candidates to managers. (招聘軟體會先篩除不完整的申請，再把合適人選轉交主管。)

meaning: phr. 季節性員工；臨時工
example: The retailer hired seasonal workers early because holiday demand was expected to exceed last year’s staffing capacity. (零售商提早聘用季節性員工，因為預期假期需求將超過去年的人力負荷。)
The revised hiring policy prohibits sexual discrimination and requires managers to document selection criteria for every role. (修訂後的招聘政策禁止性別歧視，並要求主管記錄每個職位的遴選標準。)
After repeated policy violations, the company decided to show the door to the contractor and reassign the account. (外包商一再違反規定後，公司決定請他走人，並把案子轉給別人。)
The consultant signed on for a six-month assignment after both parties approved the revised terms. (雙方核准修訂條款後，顧問簽約接受為期六個月的任務。)
The review singled out two account managers whose careful follow-up had retained several important clients. (檢討報告特別指出兩名客戶經理，他們細心追蹤而留住數位重要客戶。)
Supervisors noticed that response times slack off whenever staffing falls below the minimum on the evening shift. (主管發現晚班人力低於最低需求時，回覆速度就會變慢。)
The sought-after compliance specialist received several offers after presenting at the regional industry conference. (這位搶手的法遵專家在區域產業研討會發表後，收到多份聘約。)

meaning: phr. 特殊職務津貼；額外津貼
example: The revised compensation policy grants a special duty allowance to employees assigned to the emergency response team. (修訂後的薪酬政策為指派至緊急應變小組的員工提供特殊職務津貼。)
A senior sales associate stood in for the branch manager while she attended a regional planning meeting across town. (分店經理到市區參加區域規劃會議時，由資深業務人員代班。)
Among dozens of applications, her experience resolving complex billing complaints made her stand out to the hiring panel. (在數十份履歷中，她處理複雜帳務客訴的經驗讓她在招募小組面前脫穎而出。)
Several experienced technicians stayed on after the acquisition to train new staff and maintain service quality. (收購完成後，幾位資深技術人員繼續留任，負責訓練新人並維持服務品質。)

meaning: phr. 挺身而出；主動承擔
example: When the project needed a temporary lead, one experienced analyst stepped forward and coordinated the remaining launch tasks. (專案需要臨時負責人時，一位資深分析師挺身而出，協調剩餘的上市工作。)
The service technician stuck around after the repair to explain the updated controls to the office manager and staff. (維修完成後，服務技術人員留下來向辦公室經理和員工說明更新後的操作方式。)
The company stuck by its longtime distributor during a difficult transition and helped retrain the distributor's warehouse team. (轉型期間，公司仍支持合作多年的經銷商，並協助重新訓練其倉庫團隊。)
The company hired a system administrator to maintain secure access for its growing network of regional offices. (公司聘請系統管理員，維護日益擴大的區域辦公室網路存取安全。)
Employees may take time off after coordinating their schedules with the department manager. (員工與部門經理協調時程後，可以請假休息。)
The career center offers free résumé workshops to every unemployed person in the community. (職涯中心為社區每位失業者提供免費履歷工作坊。)

meaning: phr. 減薪讓步；工資退讓
example: Management secured a wage concession in exchange for preserving the plant’s night shift. (管理層以保留工廠夜班為條件，取得了工資讓步。)
Warehouse employees walked out after negotiations over overtime pay stalled, temporarily delaying several outbound customer orders. (加班費談判陷入僵局後，倉庫員工集體罷工，暫時延誤了幾筆客戶訂單出貨。)
Repeated overnight support shifts wore down the small operations team, so management added two people to the rotation. (反覆輪值夜間支援讓小型營運團隊疲憊不堪，因此管理階層增添兩人輪班。)
If your invoice contains a discrepancy, ask for a corrected copy before submitting it to the accounts department. (如果發票內容有誤，請先索取更正副本，再提交給會計部門。)
A service representative will attend to your request as soon as the office opens. (辦公室一開門，客服代表就會處理您的需求。)

meaning: phr. 違反保固；保固條款違約
example: The customer alleged a breach of warranty because the replacement unit failed again within the coverage period stated in the purchase documents. (替換設備在購買文件所列的保固期間內再次故障，顧客因此指稱廠商違反保固。)
After reviewing the itemized statement, the client caught on to how the additional service charge had been calculated. (檢視明細後，客戶終於理解了額外服務費的計算方式。)

meaning: phr. 消除隔閡；澄清誤會
example: The supervisor arranged a private meeting to clear the air after two colleagues disagreed over client responsibilities. (兩位同事因客戶責任分工意見不合後，主管安排私下會談來化解隔閡。)
The payroll manager called the employee to clear up a discrepancy between the submitted hours and the time sheet. (薪資經理聯絡員工，釐清申報工時與出勤表之間的差異。)
The coordinator will clue in the regional offices before announcing the revised shipping schedule to customers. (向客戶公布修訂後的出貨時程前，協調人員會先通知各區域辦公室。)
The regional director conferred with legal advisers before responding to the distributor's request for revised territory terms. (區域主管回覆經銷商要求修訂銷售區域條款前，先與法律顧問商議。)
The customer was cut off during the call, so the representative called back immediately. (通話中斷後，客服代表立刻回電給客戶。)
The desk clerk confirmed our late checkout and arranged a shuttle to the airport. (櫃檯人員確認了延後退房，並安排接駁車前往機場。)
Please check the distribution list before sending the revised notice to all branch managers. (將修訂通知寄給所有分店經理前，請先確認寄送名單。)
Once delivery dates are confirmed with every carrier, the coordinator will drop a line to the regional office. (和所有承運商確認交貨日期後，協調人員會寫信通知區域辦公室。)
The manager offered a face saver by allowing the supplier to replace the delayed shipment without penalty. (經理讓供應商免罰更換延誤貨物，替對方挽回顏面。)
The new advertisement fell flat with customers, so the marketing team prepared another version. (新廣告不受顧客歡迎，因此行銷團隊準備了另一個版本。)
Please fill in your contact details before submitting the registration form online. (線上送出報名表前，請填寫您的聯絡資料。)
New employees should fill out the tax form and return it to human resources this week. (新進員工應填寫稅務表格，並於本週交回人資部門。)
After the advertisement aired, online orders began to flood in from across the country. (廣告播出後，全國各地的網路訂單開始大量湧入。)
A service representative followed up with each customer after technicians replaced the faulty network equipment. (技術人員更換故障網路設備後，客服代表逐一追蹤每位客戶的狀況。)
The account manager got across the revised service limits before customers renewed their annual support contracts. (客戶經理在客戶續約年度支援合約前，清楚傳達了修訂後的服務範圍。)
News got around that the downtown branch would close, prompting several commercial clients to contact their account managers. (市中心分行即將關閉的消息傳開後，幾位企業客戶便聯絡了自己的客戶經理。)
Please get hold of the purchasing supervisor before confirming any changes to the supplier's payment terms. (確認變更供應商付款條件前，請先聯絡採購主管。)
The travel coordinator got in touch with the airline after the group booking disappeared from the reservation system. (團體訂位從訂位系統消失後，差旅協調人員便聯絡航空公司。)
Once the vendor saw the revised delivery map, she got the picture and accepted the proposed regional distribution plan. (廠商看到修訂後的配送地圖後便了解情況，接受了提議的區域配送方案。)
Could you glance over the revised schedule and confirm that the delivery dates are correct? (可以快速瀏覽修訂後的時程，確認配送日期正確嗎？)
The report goes into the reasons for rising costs and recommends several practical changes. (報告詳細說明成本上升的原因，並提出幾項實際改善建議。)
Please hang on while I check whether your payment has appeared in our system. (請稍等，我查一下系統是否已收到您的付款。)
The caller hung up before the agent could confirm the delivery address. (客服人員還沒確認配送地址，來電者就掛斷電話了。)
The client had a look at the revised floor plan before signing the lease for the new office. (簽下新辦公室租約前，客戶先查看了修訂後的平面圖。)
The regional provider improved healthcare delivery by coordinating clinic appointments and sharing records securely with each patient. (該地區醫療機構透過協調診所預約並安全分享病歷，改善了醫療服務。)
The complaints manager heard out the customer before offering a replacement unit and a revised installation appointment. (客訴經理先聽完顧客的說明，再提出更換設備與重新安排安裝時間。)
Please hold on while I transfer your call to the billing specialist who handled the original account request. (請稍等，我將為您轉接處理原始帳戶需求的帳務專員。)
The hotel clerk confirmed our reservation and arranged a taxi for the early morning airport transfer. (飯店櫃檯人員確認了我們的預訂，並安排清晨前往機場的計程車。)
The invoice explains each service charge in detail so customers can review the total. (發票詳細列出每項服務費用，方便顧客確認總額。)
In other words, the quoted price includes installation but does not cover future maintenance. (換句話說，報價包含安裝費，但不包含後續維護。)

meaning: phr. 資訊簡報；消息公告
example: The office circulated an information bulletin outlining revised travel reimbursement rules and submission deadlines. (辦公室發出資訊公告，說明修訂後的差旅報銷規定與繳交期限。)

meaning: phr. 一笑置之；不當回事
example: The spokesperson laughed off rumors about a possible office closure, but employees asked management for written confirmation. (發言人把辦公室可能關閉的傳聞一笑置之，但員工要求管理階層書面確認。)
Details of the merger talks leaked out before either company had informed its employees or major customers. (兩家公司尚未通知員工或主要客戶，合併談判細節就已外洩。)
Please leave out the outdated phone number when you revise the customer contact list. (修訂客戶聯絡清單時，請省略已停用的電話號碼。)
The spokesperson would not let on whether the company planned to open another location. (發言人不願透露公司是否計畫再開一家分店。)
Customers can look around the showroom before asking a sales associate for assistance. (顧客可以先在展示間四處看看，再請業務人員協助。)
The revised delivery schedule made sense to the client because it included realistic transit times and a clear contingency plan. (修訂後的配送時程很合理，因為列出實際運輸時間和明確的備案。)
Reliable weekend support matters to our largest accounts, so the service director approved a revised staffing plan. (可靠的週末支援對主要客戶很重要，因此客服主管核准了新版排班計畫。)
The booking agent mixed up two reservation codes, but the hotel corrected both records before guests arrived. (訂房專員弄錯兩組訂房代碼，但飯店在客人抵達前更正了兩筆資料。)

meaning: phr. 繼續進行；轉換話題
example: The facilitator asked the group to move on after everyone had reviewed the proposed changes to the customer return policy. (大家檢視完客戶退貨政策的修訂內容後，主持人請團隊繼續討論下一項。)

meaning: phr. 新聞快訊；新聞簡報
example: The travel coordinator checked the news bulletin before sending staff an update about the airport closure. (機場關閉後，差旅協調員先查看新聞快訊，再通知員工最新消息。)

meaning: phr. 新聞外洩；消息走漏
example: The company investigated a news leak after confidential merger details appeared in the morning papers. (機密合併細節登上早報後，公司著手調查新聞外洩事件。)

meaning: phr. 報紙標題；新聞標題
example: The editor revised the newspaper headline to make the local company's announcement easier to understand. (編輯修改報紙標題，讓讀者更容易看懂這家本地公司的公告。)
The spokesperson shared background information off the record before the press conference began. (記者會開始前，發言人提供了不供引用的背景資訊。)
Detailed product specifications are available on request from the sales department during business hours. (如有需要，可向業務部索取詳細產品規格。)
Customers may opt out of promotional emails at any time through their account settings. (顧客可隨時透過帳戶設定選擇不接收促銷電子郵件。)

meaning: phr. 口頭溝通；口語交流
example: The supervisor relied on oral communication to clarify the urgent schedule change with the field team. (主管透過口頭溝通，向外勤團隊說明緊急的時程變更。)
Please pass along the revised installation instructions to each technician before the service team visits customers tomorrow. (請在服務團隊明天拜訪客戶前，將修訂後的安裝說明轉達給每位技術人員。)
The account representative passed on the client's revised delivery requirements to logistics before the warehouse prepared the order. (客戶代表在倉庫備貨前，將客戶修訂後的配送需求轉交物流部門。)
The service agent played along with the caller's explanation while checking account records to verify the disputed transaction. (客服人員一邊配合來電者的說法，一邊查核帳戶資料以確認爭議交易。)
The service desk required positive identification before changing the billing address on the company account. (服務櫃檯要求確切身分確認後，才變更公司帳戶的帳單地址。)
Please confirm the postal address on your supplier profile before we dispatch the signed agreement. (寄出簽署完成的協議前，請確認供應商資料上的郵寄地址。)
The online order could not be processed until the customer corrected the postal code in the delivery details. (顧客修正配送資料中的郵遞區號後，線上訂單才得以處理。)
The safety manager pressed home the importance of reporting damaged equipment before another employee used it. (安全主管強調，設備損壞時必須先通報，避免其他員工繼續使用。)
The account manager put across the revised pricing clearly, helping the client understand which services were included in the contract. (客戶經理清楚傳達修訂後的價格，讓客戶了解合約包含哪些服務。)
Put differently, the revised service plan lowers monthly fees but requires customers to handle routine account updates themselves. (換句話說，修訂後的服務方案降低月費，但客戶必須自行處理例行帳戶更新。)
The product specialist put over the benefits of the updated software without relying on technical terms the client might not understand. (產品專員成功傳達新版軟體的優點，沒有使用客戶可能不懂的技術用語。)
The billing department put right the duplicate charge after the customer provided a receipt and a copy of the original invoice. (客戶提供收據和原始發票副本後，帳務部門更正了重複收費。)
The receptionist put the supplier through to the purchasing manager, who could answer questions about the revised delivery schedule. (櫃檯人員將供應商的電話接給採購經理，讓對方詢問修訂後的交貨時程。)
Our account team reached out to affected customers with revised shipping estimates and instructions for tracking delayed orders. (客戶團隊聯絡受影響的顧客，提供修訂後的出貨預估和延遲訂單追蹤說明。)

meaning: phr. 聽出言外之意；領會暗示
example: Experienced negotiators read between the lines when suppliers describe capacity as limited but avoid giving a firm delivery date. (供應商稱產能有限卻不願給出確切交期時，資深談判人員會留意言外之意。)

meaning: phr. 接待櫃檯；服務櫃檯
example: Please leave the signed delivery forms at the reception desk before the courier returns this afternoon. (請在快遞員今天下午回來前，把簽好的送貨單留在接待櫃檯。)
The client waited in the reception room while the office manager prepared the revised service contract. (辦公室經理準備修訂版服務合約時，客戶在接待室等候。)
The company’s updated policy sends a message that customer privacy is a priority. (公司更新政策傳達出重視顧客隱私的訊息。)
Could you send around the revised agenda to all department heads before tomorrow’s planning meeting? (可以在明天的規劃會議前傳閱修訂後的議程嗎？)
The shop clerk processed a return after checking the receipt and warranty terms with the customer. (店員與顧客確認收據和保固條款後，辦理了退貨。)
The chair asked each department head to keep the project update short and sweet for the visiting executives. (主席請各部門主管向來訪主管簡短扼要地報告專案進度。)
Visitors must sign in at reception and wear a temporary badge while they are inside the corporate offices. (訪客必須在櫃檯簽到，並在公司辦公室內佩戴臨時識別證。)
It took several days for the scale of the restructuring to sink in among employees across the regional offices. (區域辦公室的員工花了幾天才逐漸明白改組的規模。)

meaning: phr. 耐心等待；按兵不動
example: Customer support advised affected account holders to sit tight while engineers restored access to the payment portal. (客服建議受影響的帳戶持有人耐心等待，工程師正在恢復付款入口的存取。)
The account director called the client personally to smooth over confusion caused by conflicting delivery updates. (客戶主管親自致電，化解互相矛盾的配送通知造成的困惑。)

meaning: phr. 點心櫃檯；簡餐櫃檯
example: The airport snack counter accepted contactless payments throughout the busy morning rush. (機場點心櫃檯在繁忙的早晨尖峰時段都接受感應付款。)

meaning: phr. 軟體文件；操作文件
example: The vendor updated its software documentation before clients installed the new payroll system. (廠商在客戶安裝新的薪資系統前，更新了軟體文件。)

meaning: phr. 代表發言；表達立場
example: The regional director spoke for the entire team when she thanked the client for extending the service agreement. (客戶延長服務協議後，區域主管代表整個團隊向對方致謝。)

meaning: phr. 公開發言；勇於表達
example: Several employees spoke out about unsafe loading practices, leading management to commission an independent workplace review. (幾名員工公開指出裝載作業不安全，促使管理層委託獨立職場檢查。)
The revised proposal spells out each party’s responsibilities, review dates, and procedures for resolving disputed invoices. (修訂提案明確列出各方責任、審查日期及處理爭議帳單的程序。)
A vendor accidentally spilled the beans about the merger during a routine call before either company issued an announcement. (兩家公司發布公告前，供應商在例行通話中不慎洩漏合併消息。)
Our technical staff will stand by during the system upgrade in case branch employees need immediate assistance. (系統升級期間，技術人員會待命，隨時協助分店員工處理問題。)
At the trade show, the account executive struck up a conversation with a retailer interested in expanding its delivery options. (在商展上，客戶經理與一位想擴增配送選項的零售商攀談起來。)
To sum up the meeting, the team agreed to revise the delivery estimate and notify every affected customer by noon. (總結這場會議，團隊同意修訂交貨預估，並在中午前通知所有受影響的客戶。)
Could you take a look at the attached invoice and confirm the billing address? (可以查看附件中的發票並確認帳單地址嗎？)
Our support team will take care of the replacement request within two business days. (客服團隊會在兩個工作天內處理換貨申請。)
Let’s talk over the revised contract before sending it to the legal department. (寄給法務部門前，我們先討論修訂後的合約。)
Legal gave the thumbs up after compliance confirmed that the vendor had corrected every listed issue. (法務在法遵確認廠商已修正所有列出問題後，表示認可。)

meaning: phr. 大意如此；類似內容
example: The vendor sent an email to that effect, confirming that replacement parts would arrive before the scheduled maintenance window. (廠商寄來大意如此的電子郵件，確認替換零件會在預定維護時段前送達。)
We received no notice to the contrary, so the purchasing team proceeded with the delivery date stated in the signed agreement. (我們沒有收到相反通知，因此採購團隊依已簽署協議所載的日期安排交貨。)
The communications director toned down the announcement's language after legal staff warned that customers might interpret it as a guarantee. (法務人員提醒顧客可能將公告解讀為保證後，溝通主管緩和了公告措辭。)
I'll touch base with the freight broker tomorrow to confirm whether the revised customs documents have been accepted. (我明天會聯絡貨運承辦商，確認修訂後的報關文件是否已獲接受。)
The product team kept the redesigned packaging under wraps until distributors received the launch materials and updated price lists. (產品團隊在經銷商收到上市資料和更新價格表前，對新版包裝保密。)
The service team offered replacements to win back customers affected by the shipping delay. (客服團隊提供換貨，挽回受到配送延誤影響的顧客。)

meaning: phr. 語無倫次；詞不達意
example: During the briefing, the spokesperson's word salad left reporters unsure whether the company would revise its policy. (簡報時，發言人的話語雜亂無章，讓記者不確定公司是否會修改政策。)

meaning: phr. 煽情新聞；黃色新聞
example: The editor rejected yellow journalism and demanded documented evidence before publishing claims about the supplier. (編輯拒絕煽情新聞手法，要求先取得佐證，再刊登對供應商的指控。)
The warehouse will release replacement parts as needed while technicians repair equipment at customer locations. (技術人員在客戶現場維修設備時，倉庫會視需要提供替換零件。)

meaning: phr. 裝配線；組裝流水線
example: The factory added a second assembly line to meet increased orders while keeping its existing production schedule unchanged. (工廠增設第二條裝配線以滿足增加的訂單，同時維持原有生產時程。)
The automotive company closed its assembly plant for two days so technicians could install updated safety equipment. (汽車公司停閉組裝廠兩天，讓技術人員安裝更新的安全設備。)

meaning: phr. 汽車零件；汽車配件
example: The repair shop ordered an auto part from another branch because the local supplier could not deliver it before Friday. (當地供應商無法在星期五前送達，修車廠便向其他分店調貨一項汽車零件。)
The airline expects to book up every seat on the evening flight after adding a second daily service. (航空公司增開每日第二班航班後，預期晚班機座位將全部訂滿。)

meaning: phr. 氣泡包裝；泡殼包裝
example: The supplier switched to bubble pack for fragile accessories after several glass items arrived damaged in ordinary cartons. (幾件玻璃商品以普通紙箱寄送後破損，供應商便改用氣泡包裝易碎配件。)
The distributor buys in extra winter equipment each autumn before demand rises in northern regions. (每年秋天需求升高前，經銷商便會額外備妥冬季設備。)

meaning: phr. 汽車運輸拖車；載車拖車
example: The car carrier delivered twelve new vehicles to the dealership before its weekend showroom promotion began. (載車拖車在週末展示間促銷開始前，將十二輛新車送到經銷商。)
The shipping company loaded each cargo container onto a separate vessel after checking its seal number and destination documents. (船公司確認封條號碼和目的地文件後，將每個貨櫃裝上不同船隻。)
A cargo ship carrying imported appliances arrived at the port two days behind schedule because of severe weather. (一艘載運進口家電的貨輪因天候惡劣，比預定時間晚了兩天抵達港口。)
The supplier accepted cash on delivery for the first shipment because the new retailer had limited credit history. (由於新零售商的信用紀錄有限，供應商同意首批貨物採貨到付款。)
The regional offices will change over to the new inventory platform once staff complete their scheduled training sessions. (員工完成排定的訓練後，各區域辦公室將改用新的庫存平台。)
The warehouse crew cleaned out the damaged-goods section before the new seasonal inventory arrived. (新一季的庫存送達前，倉庫人員先清空了瑕疵品區。)
The supplier hired a common carrier to transport its products to several regional warehouses. (供應商聘請公共運輸業者將產品送往數個地區倉庫。)
The container ship will unload imported furniture at the port early tomorrow morning. (貨櫃船明天清晨會在港口卸下進口家具。)
The hotel decided to contract out laundry services to a nearby cleaning company. (飯店決定把洗衣服務外包給附近的清潔公司。)
Please dispose of the packing materials in the recycling bins behind the loading area. (請把包材丟進裝卸區後方的回收桶。)
Rising fuel prices increased distribution cost for deliveries to remote stores across the region. (燃油價格上漲提高了配送至該區偏遠商店的配送成本。)
The dock worker guided the cargo team as they unloaded containers from the overnight shipment. (碼頭工人引導貨運團隊卸下夜間到港貨物的貨櫃。)
The marina listed its docking fee clearly on the invoice provided to visiting boat owners. (碼頭在提供給來訪船主的發票上清楚列出靠泊費。)
The publisher farms out translation work to local specialists in each market. (出版社把翻譯工作外包給各市場的當地專家。)

meaning: phr. 額外附加；再多給一些
example: The supplier included several spare labels for good measure in case cartons were damaged during the long-distance shipment. (供應商額外附上幾張備用標籤，以防紙箱在長途運送中受損。)
The freight agent confirmed the delivery window and sent the warehouse an updated shipping notice. (貨運代理確認送達時段，並將更新後的出貨通知寄給倉庫。)
The supplier negotiated a lower freight rate after consolidating several orders into one shipment. (供應商將數筆訂單合併成一批貨後，談下較低的貨運費率。)

meaning: phr. 做好準備；加緊籌備
example: The warehouse is gearing up for a seasonal surge by adding temporary shifts and checking backup equipment. (倉庫增開臨時班次並檢查備用設備，為季節性業務高峰做好準備。)
The customs paperwork got stuck because the supplier's product codes did not match the import declaration. (供應商的產品代碼與進口申報不符，導致海關文件卡住了。)
The equipment company hires out portable generators to contractors working at remote construction sites. (這家設備公司將可攜式發電機出租給在偏遠工地施工的承包商。)
Technicians hooked up the backup generator before testing emergency lighting throughout the renovated conference center. (技術人員接上備用發電機後，測試了整修後會議中心的緊急照明。)
The fleet contract covers inspection and repair for every delivery van used by the regional office. (車隊合約涵蓋區域辦公室每輛配送廂型車的檢查與維修。)

meaning: phr. 庫存控管；存貨管理
example: Improved inventory control helped the distributor avoid shortages during the seasonal increase in orders. (庫存控管改善後，經銷商得以避免季節性訂單增加時發生缺貨。)
The restaurant laid in extra coffee and paper goods before the convention brought several hundred visitors downtown. (大型會議將數百名訪客帶進市區前，餐廳已預先備妥額外咖啡與紙類用品。)
We have enough left over from last month’s order to supply the smaller branch. (上個月訂單剩下的數量足以供應較小的分店。)
The printer recommended offset printing because the company needed several thousand identical brochures. (印刷商建議採用平版印刷，因為公司需要數千份相同的手冊。)

meaning: phr. 包裝商品；預先包裝食品
example: The retailer changed suppliers after packaged goods arrived with damaged labels and inconsistent expiry dates. (包裝商品送達時標籤破損、有效日期不一致，零售商因此更換供應商。)

meaning: phr. 包裹郵件；包裹郵寄
example: The supplier sent replacement parts by parcel post after the warehouse reported a shortage. (倉庫回報缺貨後，供應商以包裹郵件寄出替換零件。)

meaning: phr. 零件庫存；備用零件
example: The service manager checked the parts inventory before promising same day repairs to the client. (服務經理在承諾當天修好前，先確認了零件庫存。)

meaning: phr. 實體商品；有形商品
example: The distributor stores physical goods locally but fulfills software subscriptions through a separate online platform. (經銷商在本地儲存實體商品，但透過另一個線上平台提供軟體訂閱。)

meaning: phr. 郵資計價機；郵資蓋印機
example: The mailroom used a postage meter to process hundreds of supplier invoices before the afternoon pickup. (郵務室在下午收件前，使用郵資計價機處理數百份供應商發票。)

meaning: phr. 郵政服務；郵件遞送
example: The postal service warned vendors that deliveries to rural branches would take two additional days. (郵政服務通知廠商，寄往偏鄉分店的郵件將多花兩天送達。)

meaning: phr. 保護關稅；保護性關稅
example: The exporters warned that a protective tariff could raise costs for manufacturers that rely on imported steel. (出口商警告，保護關稅可能提高仰賴進口鋼材的製造商成本。)
The logistics team moved deliveries earlier because several rural roads close during the rainy season. (物流團隊把配送時間提前，因為幾條鄉間道路在雨季會封閉。)
Please reorder printer paper before the supply cabinet runs out completely before the next shift begins. (請在儲藏櫃的影印紙完全用完前重新訂購。)
If I receive the package while you are away, I can send it on to your new address. (如果你不在時包裹送達，我可以把它轉寄到你的新地址。)

meaning: phr. 出貨文員；運務助理
example: The shipping clerk corrected the customs forms before Friday's export deadline and notified the warehouse. (出貨文員在週五出口期限前修正報關表格，並通知了倉庫。)
A shuttle bus runs between the airport and the conference hotel every half hour. (接駁巴士每半小時往返機場與會議飯店。)
The restaurant stocked up on coffee and takeaway cups before a convention brought hundreds of visitors downtown. (會議展覽帶來數百名訪客前，餐廳先備足咖啡和外帶杯。)

meaning: phr. 貨物倉庫；存貨倉庫
example: The storage warehouse added evening shifts after retailers increased orders ahead of the holiday season. (零售商在假期旺季前增加訂單後，貨物倉庫增開了晚班。)

meaning: phr. 有形商品；實體商品
example: The retailer expanded delivery options for tangible goods while keeping digital subscriptions on a separate platform. (零售商擴增有形商品的配送選項，並將數位訂閱服務放在另一個平台。)
The textile mill installed quieter equipment after nearby residents complained about overnight noise. (附近居民抱怨夜間噪音後，紡織廠換裝了較安靜的設備。)
The maintenance crew used up its spare filters earlier than expected, so procurement arranged an emergency shipment from another branch. (維修團隊比預期更早用完備用濾網，因此採購部安排從其他分店緊急調貨。)

meaning: phr. 批發市場；批發交易市場
example: The grocer shifted to a wholesale market to secure steadier prices for seasonal produce. (雜貨商改到批發市場採購，以穩定季節性農產品的進貨價格。)
The revised budget is a bit tighter this quarter, but it still covers essential maintenance and staff training. (修訂後的預算本季稍微吃緊，但仍足以支應必要維護與員工訓練。)
The new booking system reduced customer waiting times a good deal during the busiest travel season. (新的訂位系統在旅遊旺季大幅縮短了顧客等候時間。)
The hotel can add on airport transfers to the package if guests request them when making reservations. (旅客訂房時提出需求，飯店就能在套裝行程中加上機場接送。)
The museum admission fee is waived for employees who show their company identification. (員工出示公司識別證即可免付博物館入場費。)

meaning: phr. 下班後；非營業時間
example: The building's security desk accepts urgent deliveries after hours when the regular receiving office is closed. (一般收貨辦公室關閉後，大樓警衛櫃檯仍會在非營業時間收受急件。)
Please send the revised agenda ahead of time so attendees can prepare questions for the budget review. (請提前寄出修訂後的議程，讓與會者能準備預算審查的問題。)
Please contact building maintenance because the air conditioner in our meeting room is leaking. (會議室冷氣機漏水，請聯絡大樓維修人員。)
A shuttle bus connects the downtown hotel with the air terminal every thirty minutes. (接駁車每三十分鐘往返市中心飯店和航空航廈。)
Please email me the airplane ticket receipt so I can submit the travel expenses before the monthly reimbursement deadline. (請把機票收據寄給我，讓我能在每月報帳期限前提交差旅費用。)
Our driver will meet the visiting consultants at the airport terminal after their evening flight from Singapore arrives. (我們的司機會在來訪顧問搭乘的新加坡晚班機抵達後，於機場航廈接他們。)
The service operates under the name MetroLink, also known as the city's regional commuter network. (這項服務以 MetroLink 為名營運，也就是該市的區域通勤網。)
The form requests the supplier's legal name, tax number, payment terms, delivery address, and so on. (表格要求填寫供應商法定名稱、稅籍編號、付款條件、送貨地址等等。)

meaning: phr. 預約行事曆；約會簿
example: The receptionist updated the appointment calendar after the consultant rescheduled three client meetings for the following week. (顧問將三場客戶會議改到下週後，櫃檯人員更新了預約行事曆。)
Support staff worked around the clock to restore access after a regional outage disrupted customer accounts. (區域性故障影響客戶帳戶後，支援人員日以繼夜地恢復系統存取。)
The replacement filters have not arrived as yet, so maintenance rescheduled the inspection for Friday. (替換用濾網迄今尚未送達，因此維修部門將檢查改期至週五。)
The supervisor was at a loss when two suppliers submitted conflicting delivery dates for the same order. (兩家供應商為同一筆訂單提交互相矛盾的交貨日期，主管一時不知所措。)
At first glance, the revised contract seemed straightforward, but the finance team identified several hidden fees. (乍看之下，修訂後的合約很簡單，但財務團隊發現了幾筆隱藏費用。)
Please keep your booking confirmation at hand when you arrive at the reception desk. (抵達接待櫃台時，請把訂房確認資料放在手邊。)
Please arrive at least fifteen minutes before your scheduled interview begins on Monday. (請至少在面試開始前十五分鐘抵達。)
The delivery usually takes two business days and at most four during holidays. (配送通常需要兩個工作天，假期最多四天。)
At present, the store accepts online orders only from customers in this region. (目前，這家商店只接受本地顧客的網路訂單。)
Please attach the signed form to your email before sending it to the payroll office. (請先把簽好的表格附在電子郵件中，再寄給薪資部門。)
Please attach the audio file to your expense report so the translation vendor can verify the recorded interview details. (請將音訊檔案附在費用報告中，讓翻譯廠商核對錄音訪談的細節。)
The human resources manager saved the audio recording of the staff briefing for employees who could not attend. (人資經理保存了員工簡報的錄音，供無法出席的人員參考。)

meaning: phr. 自動櫃員機；提款機
example: The nearest automated teller machine is beside the lobby entrance, and visitors can withdraw cash there during business hours. (最近的自動櫃員機在大廳入口旁，訪客可於營業時間在那裡提領現金。)
The contract went back and forth between the legal team and the supplier for several days. (合約在法務團隊和供應商之間來回修改了好幾天。)
A baggage attendant helped the traveler locate a suitcase missing from the carousel. (行李服務員協助旅客尋找轉盤上遺失的行李箱。)
The driver will meet arriving guests outside baggage claim at the main airport terminal. (司機會在主要航廈的行李提領處外迎接抵達的旅客。)
Voters placed their completed ballots in the ballot box near the entrance. (選民把填好的選票投入入口附近的投票箱。)
A bank clerk helped me update my address and replace an expired debit card. (銀行行員協助我更新地址並更換過期的金融卡。)
The final payment is due next Monday, according to the invoice we received yesterday. (依照昨天收到的發票，尾款應於下週一到期。)
Please bear in mind that the meeting room is reserved for another group after three. (請記得會議室三點後已預約給另一個團隊。)
The hotel concierge recommended a nearby beauty salon that accepts appointments by phone. (飯店禮賓人員推薦附近一家可電話預約的美容院。)
The replacement parts should arrive before long, and repairs can begin tomorrow morning. (替換零件不久後就會送達，維修可於明早開始。)
Selected customers can test the beta software and report problems before the public release. (部分顧客可測試軟體測試版，並在公開發布前回報問題。)
Customers may be better off choosing the annual plan if they use the service regularly. (如果經常使用這項服務，顧客選擇年約可能更划算。)
The audit confirmed beyond a doubt that every payment had proper approval. (稽核毫無疑問地確認每筆付款都經過適當核准。)
The flight delay was beyond our control, but the airline arranged hotel rooms for passengers. (航班延誤是我們無法控制的，但航空公司為乘客安排了飯店房間。)
Please bring your birth certificate and photo identification to complete the application. (請攜帶出生證明和附照片的身分證件完成申請。)
The team updated the customer database bit by bit to avoid disrupting daily operations. (團隊逐步更新客戶資料庫，以免影響日常作業。)
The repair crew worked until the bitter end to reopen the store before Monday morning. (維修人員工作到最後關頭，力求星期一早上前重新開店。)
I blanked out during the presentation and forgot the name of our largest client. (我簡報時一時忘記，想不起最大客戶的名稱。)
Maintenance workers will block off the main entrance while they repair the front steps. (維修人員修理前方台階時，會封閉主要入口。)

meaning: phr. 風波平息；逐漸消散
example: The executive expected the complaint to blow over, but local newspapers continued investigating the contract award. (主管原以為客訴風波會平息，但地方報紙仍持續調查合約授予案。)
The booking clerk changed our train seats after the travel schedule was updated. (旅程時刻更新後，訂票員替我們更換了火車座位。)
The supplier's latest quotation borders on unreasonable, given the repeated delays and added service charges. (考量一再延誤及額外服務費，供應商最新的報價近乎不合理。)
The hotel chain bounced back quickly after renovating its properties and retraining front desk staff. (這家連鎖飯店翻修館舍並重新訓練櫃檯人員後，很快就恢復了業績。)
Several managers felt boxed in by approval rules that prevented them from responding quickly to local clients. (幾位經理覺得受到核准規定限制，無法迅速回應當地客戶。)
The delivery truck was taken out of service after a mechanic found brake failure. (技師發現煞車故障後，配送卡車便停止營運。)
The rental agent checked the brake light before handing the car over to the customer. (租車人員交車給顧客前檢查了煞車燈。)

meaning: phr. 生計；主要收入來源
example: Custom repair work remained the shop's bread and butter even after online sales began bringing in more occasional customers. (即使網路銷售帶來更多偶爾上門的客人，客製維修仍是這家店的主要收入來源。)

meaning: phr. 大致而言；概括來說
example: Broadly speaking, the survey shows that commuters prefer reliable service over slightly cheaper monthly passes. (概括來說，調查顯示通勤族偏好可靠的服務，而非稍微便宜的月票。)

meaning: phr. 高速列車；子彈列車
example: The visiting executives took the bullet train from Osaka to Tokyo, allowing them to attend two meetings in one day. (來訪主管搭乘高速列車從大阪前往東京，因此一天內得以參加兩場會議。)
A faulty transformer caused two backup generators to burn out during the overnight power restoration. (故障的變壓器導致兩台備用發電機在夜間恢復供電時燒壞。)

meaning: phr. 公車總站；巴士轉運站
example: The company shuttle leaves from the bus terminal beside the central station every weekday morning at seven. (公司接駁車每個平日早上七點從中央車站旁的公車總站出發。)

meaning: phr. 商務旅客；出差人士
example: The hotel offers business travelers an early breakfast service and a quiet workspace near the elevators. (飯店為商務旅客提供提早供應的早餐，以及電梯附近的安靜工作空間。)
By the way, the updated supplier directory is available on the shared drive beside the latest purchasing guidelines. (順帶一提，更新後的供應商名錄已放在共用磁碟，與最新採購指南放在一起。)

meaning: phr. 客艙等級；艙房等級
example: The travel agent compared cabin class options before booking the overseas flight for the company's visiting director. (旅行社比較客艙等級後，才替公司來訪主管預訂海外航班。)
The return policy allows customers thirty calendar days to request a refund after receiving an online order. (退貨政策允許顧客在收到網路訂單後三十個日曆日內申請退款。)
The service agreement renews every calendar month, with invoices issued on the first business day of each period. (服務協議每個曆月續約一次，並於每期第一個營業日開立發票。)
After completing the inventory count, the warehouse crew called it a day and secured the loading area. (清點完庫存後，倉庫人員便收工並鎖好裝卸區。)

meaning: phr. 圓滿結束；為……畫下句點
example: The opening reception capped off a week of supplier meetings and product demonstrations at the regional headquarters. (開幕酒會為區域總部一週的供應商會議與產品展示畫下句點。)

meaning: phr. 汽車電池；車用電瓶
example: The roadside service technician replaced the car battery before the driver continued the long trip to the regional sales meeting. (道路救援技術人員先更換汽車電池，駕駛才繼續長途前往區域業務會議。)
Please check off each delivered item on the packing list before signing the carrier's receipt. (簽署承運商收據前，請在裝箱單上逐項勾選已送達的品項。)

meaning: phr. 退房時間；結帳時間
example: Please confirm the hotel's checkout time before scheduling the morning client visit and arranging transportation to the airport. (安排早上的客戶拜訪和前往機場的交通前，請先確認飯店退房時間。)

meaning: phr. 近在手邊；即將來臨
example: Keep the emergency contact list close at hand whenever the maintenance crew works inside the secured plant. (維修人員在管制廠區內作業時，請將緊急聯絡名單放在手邊。)
The portable label printer came in handy when the warehouse had to reorganize hundreds of returned products. (倉庫必須重新整理數百件退貨時，這台可攜式標籤機派上了用場。)
The IT technician used the command line interface to restore access to the office server. (資訊人員使用命令列介面恢復辦公室伺服器的存取權。)
The commuter train is crowded each morning, so many employees leave home earlier. (通勤列車每天早上都很擁擠，許多員工因此提早出門。)
The company replaces computer hardware every few years to keep office systems reliable. (公司每隔幾年更換電腦硬體，確保辦公系統可靠。)
Please report any damaged computer keyboard to the help desk for a replacement. (電腦鍵盤若有損壞，請向服務台回報以便更換。)
The bank warned customers that a con artist was calling and requesting account passwords. (銀行提醒顧客，有詐騙者來電索取帳戶密碼。)
The hotel offers a continental plan that includes breakfast for every registered guest. (飯店提供含早餐方案，所有登記房客都可享用。)
A convenience store near the station sells travel cards and snacks throughout the night. (車站附近的便利商店整晚販售交通卡和零食。)
Let’s take a short break and cool down before we continue discussing the complaint. (我們先休息一下、冷靜下來，再繼續討論客訴。)
If any scheduling problems crop up, please contact the coordinator as soon as possible. (如果突然出現排程問題，請盡快聯絡協調人員。)
Please cross out the incorrect address and write the updated location beside it. (請劃掉錯誤地址，並在旁邊寫上更新後的地點。)
The manager cut short the meeting so everyone could catch the last train home. (經理提前結束會議，讓大家能趕上最後一班回家的火車。)
